subject.title: Telegram: final reply silently lost when user navigates away from chat during agent turn (2026.7.1)

question: Should this Telegram-specific report be folded into the broader durable-final-delivery contract at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, or should maintainers retain it as a separate Telegram investigation once a navigation-dependent failure trace is supplied?
rationale: The current design intentionally edits a safe preview in place and sends a fresh final only when finalization cannot be confirmed; deciding whether the remaining work is a Telegram adapter defect or a shared delivery-contract gap requires owner judgment and real transport evidence.

options.title: Investigate under the shared delivery contract
options.body: Use this report’s trace to extend the canonical cross-channel final-delivery work, preserving the Telegram-specific trigger as acceptance evidence.

options.title: Keep a Telegram-specific child investigation
options.body: Retain this issue only if logs show a Telegram preview-finalization or normal-fallback defect distinct from the shared contract.

recommendation.title: Investigate under the shared delivery contract
recommendation.body: Use this report’s trace to extend the canonical cross-channel final-delivery work, preserving the Telegram-specific trigger as acceptance evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active maintainer-authored delivery-contract discussion that already covers related Telegram final-delivery loss.
